fullDescription: A modern EdTech SaaS dashboard with a dynamic animated pastel background and glassmorphism elements. Features a fixed sidebar navigation, vibrant indigo primary tones (#6366f1), and a multi-color gradient background (purple, pink, blue, green). Optimized for productivity platforms, learning management systems (LMS), and educational administration tools. Uses Plus Jakarta Sans for a clean, professional look with high-energy accents like rose and emerald.
prompt:
## Resumo
A sophisticated dashboard layout featuring a 280px sticky sidebar, a top toolbar with glassmorphism, and a fluid main content area. The aesthetic is defined by a slow-moving animated pastel gradient background and 'glass-card' components that use high backdrop-blur and semi-transparent borders. Primary interaction points use rich indigo gradients and shadow-heavy containers.

## Estilo Visual
Create a design system with an animated background: `linear-gradient(-45deg, #e9d5ff, #fbcfe8, #dbeafe, #dcfce7)` with `background-size: 400% 400%` and a 20s ease-infinite keyframe animation. Typography: Use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' as the primary font; Headings should be ExtraBold (800) with tracking-tight (-0.025em). Colors: Primary Indigo (#6366f1), Primary Dark (#4f46e5), Accent Rose (#f43f5e), Emerald (#10b981), Amber (#f59e0b). UI elements must use 'Glassmorphism' containers: background `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85)`, `backdrop-filter: blur(12px)`, and a subtle `1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5)` border. Shadow style: Large soft shadows for active elements (`shadow-xl shadow-indigo-200/50`).

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky Sidebar
Width: 280px. Height: 100vh. Sticky position. Background: white with 90% opacity and 20px backdrop-blur. Layout: Vertical flex. Top section: Branding with 40px indigo icon container and 20px ExtraBold text. Center: Nav list with 8px vertical spacing; active items use background #6366f1, white text, and shadow-lg. Bottom: Account profile card inside a light indigo (#f5f3ff) container with border-radius 16px.

### Top Header Tool Bar
Height: 80px. Background: `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4)` with `backdrop-blur-md`. Sticky top. Padding: 0 32px. Content: Left side breadcrumb navigation with chevron-right icons; Right side: Search input (min-width 256px) with icon and 12px rounded corners, plus individual utility buttons (bell, settings) in 42px white squares with subtle borders.

### Hero Welcome Section
Container: `radial-gradient(circle at top left, #4f46e5 0%, #6366f1 40%, #8b5cf6 100%)`. Border-radius: 40px (2.5rem). Padding: 40px. Content: Two-column flex. Heading size: 48px. Includes a capsule badge for status (e.g., 'Welcome back') using `white/20` background and backdrop-blur. Add abstract decorative circles in the background with `blur(60px)`.

### Statistics Grid
Grid layout: 4 columns. Components: Glass-cards with 24px padding and 24px border-radius. Icons: 48px square containers with background color matching the icon color at 10% opacity. Features: Tiny sparkline-style bar charts or growth percentage indicators (+2% today) in font-bold emerald text.

### Schedule & AI Insights Row
Two-column grid (ratio 2:1). Left: Schedule list with hoverable 16px rounded rows. Right: AI Insights card with dark indigo background (#312e81), 32px padding, and 32px border-radius. Use high-contrast accents (Emerald/Rose dots) to indicate priority in the insights list.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Floating AI Trigger Button — A circular floating button with notification badge and bounce animation.
Size: 56px. Background: #6366f1. Shape: Circle. Shadow: `0 20px 25px -5px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.5)`. Icon: 24px white brain-circuit icon. Animation: Continuous subtle bounce (vertical 10px shift over 3s ease-in-out). Micro-interaction: Scale 110% on hover, 95% on click. Include a 20px notification badge at top-right with #f43f5e background and white 10px bold text.

### Active Sidebar Link — High-contrast navigation state with depth.
Background: #6366f1. Text color: #FFFFFF. Border-radius: 16px. Box-shadow: `0 10px 15px -3px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.3)`. Font-weight: 700. Padding: 14px 16px. Transition: 200ms ease-all.

### Metric Progress Card — Mini data visualization cards for progress tracking.
Glass-card container. Header: Uppercase 10px tracking-widest label. Value: Large 24px Black (900 weight) indigo/rose/emerald text. Footer: Full-width 8px progress bar with `bg-slate-100` track and colored fill.
